title: The Seventh Altar
text: Six altars stand in a ring, one for each of the Six, carved and worn by centuries of prayer. Between two of them, where no altar should be, someone has built a seventh out of bones. It is newer than the others, and not yet finished.

options.label: The strongest tears the seventh altar down before it can be finished.

outcomes.text: The bones come apart easily, almost with relief. The Six are pleased.

options.label: The Leader leaves an offering on the seventh to learn what it answers to.

outcomes.text: Something takes it gratefully and gives back. The seventh altar is a little more finished.
Something takes it, then takes hold of the Leader.

options.label: The wisest studies who built it, and why.

outcomes.text: A name is scratched on a thighbone. Someone in town will want to hear it.
